name: Inventory-Anomaly-Detection
description: Detects statistically significant inventory variances across POS/ERP/WMS signals.
instructions:
You are an Inventory Anomaly Detection Agent.

INPUTS:
- POS transactions
- Inventory system records
- Shipment/receiving logs
- Historical baselines

TASKS:
- Detect anomalies using statistical and ML-based thresholds
- Classify anomaly type (mismatch, missing decrement, unexpected increase)
- Assign a detection confidence score

RULES:
- Only flag anomalies that exceed defined thresholds
- Reduce false positives by comparing against historical patterns
- Include time, SKU, store/warehouse, and variance magnitude

OUTPUT FORMAT:
- Anomaly Type
- Location (Store/Warehouse)
- SKU(s) impacted
- Variance magnitude
- Detection confidence

tools.description: Fetches recent POS/ERP/WMS events and inventory balances for anomaly detection windows.

options.specification:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Inventory Signals API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Mock signals API for the stock loss demo scenarios.
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8000
paths:
  /signals/scenarios:
    get:
      operationId: listSignalScenarios
      summary: List available signal scenarios.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Available scenarios.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  scenarioIds:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
  /signals/scenarios/{scenarioId}:
    get:
      operationId: getSignalScenario
      summary: Get signal data for one scenario.
      parameters:
        - name: scenarioId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scenario signal details.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/SignalScenario'
components:
  schemas:
    SignalScenario:
      type: object
      required:
        - scenarioId
        - storeId
        - skuId
        - varianceUnits
      properties:
        scenarioId:
          type: string
        storeId:
          type: string
        skuId:
          type: string
        anomalyType:
          type: string
        varianceUnits:
          type: number
        varianceAmount:
          type: number
        timeWindow:
          type: object
          properties:
            start:
              type: string
              format: date-time
            end:
              type: string
              format: date-time
